findings.reason: Two different acts now read one character apart inside the same drawer: this close control is 关闭请求 while the ask card's own dismiss heading is 关闭此请求 ('Dismiss this ask'). Both are accessible names, so a screen-reader user meets them together with nothing but 此 to separate 'close the drawer' from 'dismiss this ask'. The shipped analogue for this control is 关闭审批面板 (ui.browser.browser_approvals_dock.close_approvals, 'Close approvals'), which also names the panel; 关闭请求面板 adopts that pattern without widening the string by more than one CJK cell beyond the English.
